name: tdd-guardian
description: TDD Guardian — enforces strict test-driven development discipline with quality gates, coverage enforcement, and mutation testing. Works with Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Enforces strict test-driven development discipline with quality gates, coverage enforcement, and mutation testing
interface.longDescription: TDD Guardian ensures rigorous test-driven development practices: test-first workflow enforcement, coverage gates (100% lines, functions, branches, statements), mutation testing for validating test strength, and behavior-driven test quality validation. Works across Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex CLI.
